description: New v10 diagnostic development cases authored after rubric freeze; two paired positive/negative cases, no independent benchmark. No expected labels in this input.

results.prompt: Check 2026-06-13 09:10–09:25 Asia/Taipei on the test calendar.

criteria: Report that the requested slot is busy or unavailable because it overlaps an existing event.

If the answer describes the conflicting event, preserve the event instant: 2026-06-12 18:00–18:30 America/Los_Angeles (PDT), or its equivalent 2026-06-13 09:00–09:30 Asia/Taipei. Either timezone is allowed; a query-window conversion is optional.
If the answer converts the requested query window to Los Angeles time, it must use 2026-06-12 18:10–18:25. Omitting this optional conversion is acceptable.
Preserve the requested 2026-06-13 09:10–09:25 Asia/Taipei query interval.
Every claimed Pacific timezone label must match the date. 2026-06-12 in Los Angeles uses PDT (UTC-07:00).

Check conversion-claim consistency separately from whether the original event time matches the tool. The requested timezone is Asia/Taipei. If the event is described as converted to the requested timezone (including in parentheses), the answer must display that event in Asia/Taipei. A line still labelled America/Los_Angeles fails this check even if its original clock values match the tool. If no event conversion is claimed, PASS this check.

Check the displayed event conversion date and clock values independently. If an event conversion to Asia/Taipei is claimed, it must display 2026-06-13 09:00–09:30. Every such conversion claim must be correct. If no event conversion is claimed, PASS this check.
forbidden_behaviors: Claim that an event was created or reserved
Claim that other calendars were checked
